summary: Pydantic-based relational AST: 8 Substrait-aligned node types (Read, Project, Filter, Sort, Fetch, Join, Aggregate, Set) plus 5 Mountainash extensions (ExtensionRelNode, SourceRelNode, RefRelNode, ResourceReadRelNode, ConformRelNode). Each node carries metadata and an accept() method for visitor dispatch.

key_classes.name: RelationNode
key_classes.purpose: Abstract Pydantic base with accept() for visitor dispatch

key_classes.name: ReadRelNode
key_classes.purpose: Leaf node wrapping a raw DataFrame input

key_classes.name: ProjectRelNode
key_classes.purpose: Column selection/rename/expression projection (4 modes via ProjectOperation)

key_classes.name: FilterRelNode
key_classes.purpose: Row filtering with boolean expression predicate

key_classes.name: ConformRelNode
key_classes.purpose: Schema conformance node storing TypeSpec; defers transform to compile time when column info available

key_classes.name: RefRelNode
key_classes.purpose: DAG reference to another named relation

key_classes.name: ResourceReadRelNode
key_classes.purpose: DAG resource read from DataPackage path

key_classes.name: ExtensionRelNode
key_classes.purpose: Parameterised by ExtensionRelOperation enum for utility operations (unnest, etc.)

extension_points: New node types for new relation operations
ExtensionRelOperation enum for new extension operations
lifecycle_notes: ConformRelNode added 2026-05 — enables compile-time schema conformance with column information
13 total node types: 8 Substrait + 5 Mountainash extension
Physical directory separation: substrait/ vs extensions_mountainash/
documentation_hooks: Node type to Substrait spec mapping
